dev.kf.lidonce.lifetime: A one-time non-consumable unlocks closed-lid keep-awake permanently. US base price US$4.99; mainland China CNY38. No subscription or renewal. Open-lid mode is always free. The optional separate free 7-day Trial starts only after the free component is ready; expiry never interrupts an accepted session. Lifetime purchase passed in actual TestFlight 17; Restore Purchases passed again in build 18.
